column1: See the "Live Check 6 Oct" tab for new problems found on the live site that were not in the original sheet.
How the developer should use this file
1. Start with the "Site-wide Fixes" tab - these repeat on many pages and can be fixed with one find-and-replace each.
2. Then work through each category tab (or "All Findings"), High priority first. Open the Page URL, press Ctrl+F and search for the "Current text (find)" value.

3. Replace it with the "Replacement text". Keep the page formatting; only the words change. FAQ answers, tables, calculators and page schema (JSON-LD) must be updated too if they repeat the same text.

4. "Live check 6 Oct" shows what was actually on the live site on 6 October 2026. Rows marked Fixed are pre-set to Done; everything else is To do. "Schema not updated" means the FAQ schema (JSON-LD) in the page code still has the old wording.

5. Set the Status column to Done, or "Query with RMA" for anything unclear. Rows marked "LEGEND-checked" are set to "Query with RMA" - do not publish them until Navpreet has approved them in the RMA Review tab.
6. After fixes, update each page's "General information current as at" line to October 2026.
